annotations.title: Open a ticket with the JusticeLibre team

description: Opens a ticket with the JusticeLibre team ON BEHALF of the user (marked "via AI") to report wrong data, a missing source, a bug, or an idea. Use only if the user asks for it or approves it. Permission tickets; AI limits on top of the user's own: 3 tickets a day, 5 messages an hour; 3 plain-text attachments at most. Replies are read with get_account_item. Requires a JusticeLibre account (OAuth sign-in); without one, the tool says so.

message.description: What is wrong, what is expected, the source. 4,000 characters at most.

target.description: The reference or URL concerned ("article:CT:L1234-1", a URL).

title.description: Precise title, 120 characters at most ("CT L1234-1: wrong renumbering date").

type.description: error (wrong data), missing (source or text missing), bug, idea.

name: open_ticket
